_note: Hit-stop by weight, with a freeze budget (Game Design's rulings-2026-10-19b.md 4a and 4b, fight-feel.md section 6; sim/core/hitstop.gd; docs/architecture/feel-core.md).
_enabled: the one switch. SimCore.newMatch copies it into S.hitstopOn unless the match's setup has its own "hitstop". Off: every hit holds the clock as today, no budget state, and this file is not read into a replay

ticks._note: a hit's stop in ticks by the weight it names (o.weight). A mashed or burst light 2 to 3 (3, and mashFloor over the budget); a launch or a close 14, a full launch 16; decisive: a finisher's last, a duel of perfects' send, a blow that breaks a region (the core's); ko: the hit that ends the match, the cap

budget._note: the frozen time of the last windowS live seconds is at most share of it (12% of a minute: 432 ticks). Over it, a mashed light holds mashFloor
